scope: Primary player implementation; semantic inspection only,no code copied into fvid.
observations: positionJump stores destination order minus one, resets break row to zero and sets position-jump flag.
patternBreak updates only break row and jump flag; it preserves the previously selected song position.
At row transition, selected order increments and break row is applied. Thus Bxx followed by Dxx retains the B destination; Dxx followed by Bxx resets row zero.
